function.name: Write
function.description: Use this tool to create a new file with content or modify existing files. Provide an absolute file_path, the file_content (at most 1000 lines), and optionally add_last_line_newline.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the target file

add_last_line_newline.description: Whether to add newline at end

function.name: DeleteFile
function.description: Delete a file safely. ONLY use this tool to delete a file; the path must be absolute.

file_path.description: The file path to delete. Must be an absolute path.

function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute a shell command in the terminal. For terminal operations like git, npm, docker. Do not use it for file read/write/edit. Prefer absolute paths. Set is_background=true for long-running commands, then poll with GetTerminalOutput.

command.description: The shell command to execute (max 500 characters).

command_names.description: The primary command names used, e.g. ["git"].

has_risk.description: Whether the command is potentially destructive.

is_background.description: Run in the background and return a terminal id.

function.name: GetTerminalOutput
function.description: Get the output of a terminal command previously started with Bash. Waits for completion according to wait_seconds.

terminal_id.description: The ID of the terminal command output to check.

wait_seconds.description: Wait time in seconds: 2 for quick commands, 15 for builds/tests, 30 for app start, up to 180 for long tasks. Default 2.

function.name: GetProblems
function.description: Get compile or lint errors for one or more files.

file_paths.description: Absolute paths of the files to check.
